title: JIATF-401 Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) W912CH-26-S-X001
agency: JIATF-401 via Army Contracting Command–Detroit Arsenal
type: Commercial Solutions Opening: rolling solution briefs, then presentations and proposals; fixed-price awards
deadline: Open through 31 Dec 2028 (rolling; specific calls have their own suspense dates)
amount: Fixed-price contracts or agreements; sizes vary (pilots to production)
fit_note: The main front door to JIATF-401. Three capability management offices: Mobile (rapidly transportable C-UAS for border defense, special events and emerging needs), Fixed Site (tied to the marketplace) and C2. A canister-launched interceptor with onboard sensing belongs in Mobile. Questions go to the published CSO mailbox. Foreign firms may submit or team with US firms.

title: NAWCAD Thunderdome — low-cost C-UAS interceptors (annual)
agency: Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, UX-24 squadron, NAWC Webster Outlying Field (NISE-sponsored)
deadline: 2026 event held 17–21 Aug (responses closed 17 Jul 2026); watch for 2027
fit_note: 2026 requirements: interceptor under 18 lb, at least 85 knots, under $25,000 to produce, and non-kinetic during field testing. UM's tethered-rope capture is non-kinetic and its $25K airframe placeholder sits at the cost cap. The cleanest published spec match to UM so far.

title: DIU Bridge Program CLASS ACT — maritime counter-unmanned systems (HQ084526SC002)
type: Prototype OT with possible noncompetitive production; brings uncleared firms into the cleared base
fit_note: Requires TRL 7+ and Top Secret work. UM is too early, but the program is a route to a facility clearance for a later cycle.
